verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents read-write support for listItems and driveItems, and `?expand=fields` returns item field values, so per-file metadata can be read and written via the API. However, nothing in the evidence documents defining custom schemas or metadata templates (custom columns or content types), or querying files by those properties. Missing for 10: documented custom column/content-type schema definition, API-based filtering/querying by custom properties, explicit examples of setting custom metadata on files, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API

citations.quote: You can expand references in your URL with the _expand_ query parameter; for example, `?expand=fields`.
Use **PUT** and **MERGE** operations to update existing SharePoint objects.
